THOUGHT AND CHARACTER


CHAPTER I.

THOUGHT AND CHARACTER


The aphorism, "As a man thinketh in his heart so is he," not only
embraces the whole of a man's being, but is so comprehensive as to
reach out to every condition.

[Illustration: a picture]

A man is literally _what he thinks_, his character
being the complete sum of all his thoughts.
